## Purpose
`doctor.ts`'s `DoctorCheck`/`DoctorStatus` and `projects.ts`'s `ProjectDetection` are this subproject's "check" shapes: a small interface reporting the outcome of a fail-open probe the backend already ran (installed?, doctor status, artifact drift). Both files open with a header naming the single backend command they wrap and stating, explicitly, that components must import from the wrapper file rather than call `call()` themselves. Both normalise the raw wire strings defensively before handing them to the UI, so a malformed/unexpected backend value degrades to a safe default instead of propagating.

## Convention
Folder: apps/dashboard/src/lib/** · Extension: .ts · Files of this role in this subproject: 2
A check interface's fields describe a yes/no or small-enum outcome plus enough context to render it (`installed`/`version`, `overall`/`checks`/`error`) — never a raw untyped blob. When the backend returns a narrower or looser string than the TS union promises, the wrapper defines a private `normalise*` function (`normaliseStatus`, `normaliseOverall`) that maps any unrecognised value to a safe default (`"warn"`) rather than throwing or passing it through. The async wrapper function is named after the probe verb (`doctorStatus`, `detectProjectMustard`) and is the only call site for the underlying `call()` command.

## How to apply
A new check-style probe gets its `export interface` (the check's outcome shape) plus an `async function` wrapper in the `lib/*.ts` file that owns the concern (a new file if it is a new subsystem, otherwise append to the existing one under a `// ---` banner). If the backend's status field is a loose string, add a private `normalise*` guard next to it, following `doctor.ts`.

## Examples
Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/doctor.ts
```ts
export type DoctorCheckStatus = "ok" | "warn" | "fail" | "skip";

export interface DoctorCheck {
  name: string;
  status: DoctorCheckStatus;
  message: string;
  details: string[];
}

function normaliseStatus(s: string): DoctorCheckStatus {
  return s === "ok" || s === "warn" || s === "fail" || s === "skip"
    ? s
    : "warn";
}
```

Ref: apps/dashboard/src/lib/projects.ts
```ts
export interface ProjectDetection {
  /** True when the project-root `<path>/mustard.json` exists (the workspace
   *  anchor every install writes — `.claude/CLAUDE.md` is no longer planted). */
  installed: boolean;
  /** Mustard CLI version stamped into `<path>/mustard.json`, when
   *  readable. `null` when the file is missing or malformed. */
  version: string | null;
}

export function detectProjectMustard(path: string): Promise<ProjectDetection> {
  return call<ProjectDetection>("detect_project_mustard", { path });
}
```
